steps.text: The child-shaped entity gives you another banner.

steps.npc: I'm the eldest of the Gnome children and master of tasks for the Western Provinces Achievement Diary.

It's a diary that helps you keep track of particular achievements. In the Western Provinces it can help you discover some quite useful things. Eventually, with enough exploration, the inhabitants will reward you.
You can see the list of tasks on the side-panel.

options.text: I have a question about my Achievement Diary

steps.player: I have a question about my Achievement diary.

steps.npc: Well, there are four different Western banners, which match up with the four levels of difficulty. Each has the same rewards as the previous level and some additional benefits too... which tier of rewards would you like to
know more about?

steps.player: Tell me more about the Easy rewards please!

steps.npc: If you complete all of the easy tasks in the Western Diary, you have a 25% chance of 2 Chompy birds appearing when hunting and Rantz will provide you with 25 free ogre arrows every day.

steps.player: Tell me more about the Medium rewards please!

steps.npc: In addition to the easy rewards, the Crystal saw will last for twice as long before reverting to seed, you have a 50% chance of 2 Chompy birds appearing when hunting and Rantz will provide you with 50 free ogre
arrows every day.

steps.player: Tell me more about the Hard rewards please!

steps.npc: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, Ilfeen of the Elves can enchant your crystal seed into a Halberd, a locked door under Ape Atoll becomes unlocked, The Void Knights can upgrade your Void armour, the

Hunter master in the Feldip hills will allow you to hunt in his private hunting ground, teleport crystals can now hold 5 charges, Rantz will provide you with 100 ogre arrows every day and the banner will teleport you to
Piscatoris once per day.

steps.player: Tell me more about the Elite rewards please!

steps.text: If the player has not completed Monkey Madness II:

steps.npc: In addition to the previous tiers of rewards, two Chompy birds will always appear and they have a chance of dropping a pet, Nieve will reward your slayer assignments with more points and Rantz will provide
you with 150 free ogre arrows every day. The banner will teleport you to Piscatoris as much as you desire and you may resurrect once per day while battling Zulrah.

steps.text: If the player has completed Monkey Madness II:

steps.npc: In addition to the previous tiers of rewards, two Chompy birds will always appear and they have a chance of dropping a pet, Steve will reward your slayer assignments with more points and Rantz will provide
you with 150 free ogre arrows every day. The banner will teleport you to Piscatoris as much as you desire and you may resurrect once per day while battling Zulrah.

options.text: How do I claim the rewards?

steps.player: How do I claim the rewards?

steps.npc: Just complete the tasks in the Western provinces so they're ticked off, then come and speak to me for your rewards.
Goodbye adventurer.

easy-tasks-completed.player: I've completed all of the easy tasks in my Western Achievement Diary!

easy-tasks-completed.npc: I can see that, well done! You'll be wanting your reward then!

easy-tasks-completed.text: If the player doesn't have 2 inventory spaces:
an Antique lamp and Western Banner 1

easy-tasks-completed.npc: This banner is a symbol of your exploration of the Western Provinces. You now have a 25% chance of 2 Chompy birds appearing when hunting and Rantz will provide you with 25 free ogre arrows every day.
If you ever lose your banner, come back to me to reclaim it.

medium-tasks-completed.player: I've completed all of the medium tasks in my Western achievement diary!

medium-tasks-completed.text: If the player hasn't completed all the previous tasks:

steps.npc: You need to complete all of the easy too before I can reward you for the more difficult sets.
